method: Modal HTML only after WP bootstrap, three calls per case in one process, no external cache flush. First blank pass precedes selected passes. Times are not full-page TTFB.

queries:
SELECT  t.term_id
			 FROM wp_terms AS t  INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy AS tt ON t.term_id = tt.term_id
			 WHERE tt.taxonomy IN ('recipe_tags') AND tt.count > 0
			 ORDER BY tt.count DESC
			 LIMIT 6
SELECT t.*, tt.* FROM wp_terms AS t INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy AS tt ON t.term_id = tt.term_id WHERE t.term_id IN (5184,5188,5182,5196,5205,5181)

SELECT  t.term_id
			 FROM wp_terms AS t  INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy AS tt ON t.term_id = tt.term_id
			 WHERE tt.taxonomy IN ('recipe_tags') AND t.slug IN ('%d1%81%d0%b0%d1%85%d0%b0%d1%80', '%d1%81%d0%be%d0%bb%d1%8c', '%d0%bc%d0%be%d0%bb%d0%be%d0%ba%d0%be')
			 ORDER BY t.name ASC
			 LIMIT 3
